family.description: This domain is found in human Distal membrane-arm assembly complex protein 1 (DMAC1), which is required for the assembly of the mitochondrial NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase complex, Tam6 from Schizosaccharomyces pombe (also known as Dmo2), which is required for the stability and maturation of Cox2p, the second subunit of the COX complex, and similar eukaryotic proteins. This domain is predicted to show two alpha helices.
family.name: DMAC1/Dmo2-like domain
